description: Na₂Ge₂Si₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.80 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.16 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to six O atoms to form GeO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-40°. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-36°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four GeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-35°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Si atom.
